{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_015UFgqq7xq7gQ2pUUTevHxC","type":"tool_result","content":"// QT Clustering Benchmark - Simplified Sequential Version\n// \n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Find the closest unclustered point to the current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n// Returns -1 if no such point exists\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    \n    // Try each unclustered point as a candidate\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        // Skip if already clustered or already in this cluster\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        \n        // Calculate the maximum distance from candidate to all cluster members\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n        \n        // If adding this point keeps diameter below threshold and is better than current best\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return closest_point;\n}\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    \n    // Add seed point\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n    \n    // Iteratively add closest points\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        // Find closest point to current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n        const int closest = findClosestPoint(members, clustered, in_cluster, points, \n                                             threshold, point_count);\n        \n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n        \n        in_cluster[closest] = true;\n        members.push_back(closest);\n    }\n    \n    // Copy members if requested\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n    \n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    \n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n    \n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n        \n        // Try each unclustered point as a seed\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < unclustered_indices.size(); ++i) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            if (clustered[seed]) continue;\n            \n            std::vector<int> candidate_members;\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, points, \n                                                       threshold, N, \n                                                       &candidate_members);\n            \n            if (cardinality > max_cardinality) {\n                max_cardinality = cardinality;\n                best_seed = seed;\n                best_cluster_members = candidate_members;\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = best_cluster_members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n            \n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < best_cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n                clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;\n            }\n            \n            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n                unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n            // No more clusters can be formed\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n    \n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n    \n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        \n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]], \n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        \n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\", \n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n        \n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\", \n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n    \n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\", \n               num_points, threshold);\n        return 1;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n    printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Generate synthetic data\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n    \n    // Perform QT clustering\n    auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold);\n    \n    auto cluster_end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto cluster_time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(\n        cluster_end - cluster_start);\n    \n    printf(\"Clustering time: %ld ms\\n\", cluster_time.count());\n    printf(\"Clusters found: %zu\\n\", clusters.size());\n    \n    // Calculate statistics and performance metrics\n    int total_clustered = 0;\n    int max_cluster_size = 0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters.size(); ++i) {\n        const int size = static_cast<int>(clusters[i].members.size());\n        total_clustered += size;\n        max_cluster_size = std::max(max_cluster_size, size);\n    }\n    \n    const double avg_cluster_size = clusters.empty() ? 0.0 : \n        static_cast<double>(total_clustered) / clusters.size();\n    \n    printf(\"Points clustered: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\\n\", \n           total_clustered, num_points, \n           100.0 * total_clustered / num_points);\n    printf(\"Average cluster size: %.2f\\n\", avg_cluster_size);\n    printf(\"Maximum cluster size: %d\\n\", max_cluster_size);\n    \n    // Performance metrics\n    const double time_sec = cluster_time.count() / 1000.0;\n    const double clusters_per_sec = clusters.size() / time_sec;\n    const double points_per_sec = num_points / time_sec;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.1f clusters/s, %.1f points/s\\n\", \n           clusters_per_sec, points_per_sec);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        // Serialize cluster membership for hashing\n        std::vector<double> membershipData;\n        membershipData.reserve(num_points);\n        std::vector<int> membership(num_points, -1);\n        for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < membershipData.push_back(static_cast<double>(m));\n        }\n        print_results(membershipData, \"ClusterMembership\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        const bool printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return 0;\n}\n---\n#pragma once\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <cinttypes>\n#include <cmath>\n#include 0.0;\n    for (const auto& val : data) {\n        T y = val - c;\n        T t = sum + y;\n        c = (t - sum) - y;\n        sum = t;\n    }\n    return sum;\n}\n\n// Print results for floating-point QT Clustering Benchmark - Simplified Sequential Version\n// \n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Find the closest unclustered point to the current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n// Returns -1 if no such point exists\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    \n    // Try each unclustered point as a candidate\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        // Skip if already clustered or already in this cluster\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        \n        // Calculate the maximum distance from candidate to all cluster members\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n        \n        // If adding this point keeps diameter below threshold and is better than current best\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return closest_point;\n}\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    \n    // Add seed point\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n    \n    // Iteratively add closest points\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        // Find closest point to current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n        const int closest = findClosestPoint(members, clustered, in_cluster, points, \n                                             threshold, point_count);\n        \n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n        \n        in_cluster[closest] = true;\n        members.push_back(closest);\n    }\n    \n    // Copy members if requested\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n    \n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    \n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n    \n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n        \n        // Try each unclustered point as a seed\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < unclustered_indices.size(); ++i) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            if (clustered[seed]) continue;\n            \n            std::vector<int> candidate_members;\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, points, \n                                                       threshold, N, \n                                                       &candidate_members);\n            \n            if (cardinality > max_cardinality) {\n                max_cardinality = cardinality;\n                best_seed = seed;\n                best_cluster_members = candidate_members;\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = best_cluster_members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n            \n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < best_cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n                clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;\n            }\n            \n            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n                unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n            // No more clusters can be formed\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n    \n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n    \n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        \n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]], \n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        \n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\", \n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n        \n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\", \n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011CgMQ8R7NLcw9asnPUP36T","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_018TWRadhsU7yng3DhshcmJE","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp <<'EOF'\n// QT Clustering Benchmark - CUDA Parallel Version\n//\n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n//\n// Parallelization strategy (CUDA):\n//   Every outer iteration of the algorithm has to grow one candidate cluster\n//   from each still-unclustered seed point. These candidate clusters are\n//   completely independent of each other, so each one is grown by its own\n//   thread block. Inside a block, the threads cooperatively own the set of\n//   candidate points: for each candidate the block keeps the running maximum\n//   distance to the members already in the cluster (updated incrementally\n//   whenever a new member joins, which is exactly the maximum the original\n//   code recomputes from scratch), and a block-wide argmin reduction selects\n//   the next member with the same tie-breaking as the sequential scan\n//   (smallest distance, then smallest index). Only the cardinality of each\n//   candidate cluster is produced in this pass; the winning cluster is then\n//   re-grown by a single block to enumerate its members.\n//\n//   The unclustered points are compacted into a dense array (in ascending\n//   index order) before every iteration so that no work is spent on points\n//   that are already clustered.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                        \\\n    do {                                                                        \\\n        cudaError_t err__ = (call);                                             \\\n        if (err__ != cudaSuccess) {                                             \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d: %s\\n\", #call, __FILE__,    \\\n                    __LINE__, cudaGetErrorString(err__));                       \\\n            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);                                                 \\\n        }                                                                       \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA kernels\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nnamespace {\n\nconstexpr int kBlockSize = 256;\nconstexpr int kWarpSize = 32;\nconstexpr int kNumWarps = kBlockSize / kWarpSize;\n// Largest dynamic shared memory allocation we are willing to request for the\n// per-candidate running-maximum array (96 KiB, available on sm_70+).\nconstexpr size_t kMaxSmemBytes = 96 * 1024;\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ double devDistance(const double2 a, const double2 b) {\n    const double dx = a.x - b.x;\n    const double dy = a.y - b.y;\n    return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// (value, index) pair ordering identical to the sequential scan: a candidate\n// replaces the current best only if it is strictly closer, so among equal\n// distances the smallest index wins.\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool betterThan(double v, int i, double bv, int bi) {\n    return (v < bv) || (v == bv && i < bi);\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ void warpArgMin(double& v, int& i) {\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int off = kWarpSize / 2; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n        const double ov = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, v, off);\n        const int oi = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, i, off);\n        if (betterThan(ov, oi, v, i)) {\n            v = ov;\n            i = oi;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Grow one candidate cluster per block (grid-stride over seeds).\n//\n//   pts        : compacted coordinates of the U unclustered points\n//   U          : number of unclustered points (== number of candidate seeds)\n//   threshold  : diameter threshold\n//   seedBase   : first seed handled by block 0 (used for the single-seed pass)\n//   numSeeds   : number of seeds to process\n//   card       : output cardinality per seed\n//   scratch    : per-block global scratch (U doubles per block) if !SMEM\n//   members    : if RECORD, members of the (single) grown cluster in join order\ntemplate <bool SMEM, bool RECORD>\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(kBlockSize)\ngrowClustersKernel(const double2* __restrict__ pts,\n                   const int U,\n                   const double threshold,\n                   const int seedBase,\n                   const int numSeeds,\n                   int* __restrict__ card,\n                   double* __restrict__ scratch,\n                   int* __restrict__ members) {\n    extern __shared__ double dynSmem[];\n    __shared__ double redVal[kNumWarps];\n    __shared__ int redIdx[kNumWarps];\n    __shared__ int sNext;\n\n    double* maxd = SMEM ? dynSmem : scratch + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * U;\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int lane = tid & (kWarpSize - 1);\n    const int warp = tid >> 5;\n    const double INF = INFINITY;\n\n    for (int s = blockIdx.x; s < numSeeds; s += gridDim.x) {\n        const int seed = seedBase + s;\n\n        // Initialise: nothing in the cluster but the seed. A running maximum\n        // of 0 makes the first update produce exactly dist(candidate, seed);\n        // +inf marks points that are members of this cluster.\n        for (int c = tid; c < U; c += kBlockSize) {\n            maxd[c] = (c == seed) ? INF : 0.0;\n        }\n        if (RECORD && tid == 0) members[0] = seed;\n\n        int member = seed;\n        int count = 1;\n\n        while (true) {\n            __syncthreads();  // maxd initialised / previous member published\n            const double2 mp = pts[member];\n\n            double bestV = INF;\n            int bestI = INT_MAX;\n            for (int c = tid; c < U; c += kBlockSize) {\n                double v = maxd[c];\n                if (v != INF) {\n                    const double d = devDistance(pts[c], mp);\n                    v = fmax(v, d);\n                    maxd[c] = v;\n                    if (v < threshold && betterThan(v, c, bestV, bestI)) {\n                        bestV = v;\n                        bestI = c;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n            warpArgMin(bestV, bestI);\n            if (lane == 0) {\n                redVal[warp] = bestV;\n                redIdx[warp] = bestI;\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n            if (warp == 0) {\n                double v = (lane < kNumWarps) ? redVal[lane] : INF;\n                int i = (lane < kNumWarps) ? redIdx[lane] : INT_MAX;\n                warpArgMin(v, i);\n                if (lane == 0) {\n                    sNext = i;\n                    if (i != INT_MAX) {\n                        maxd[i] = INF;\n                        if (RECORD) members[count] = i;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n            const int next = sNext;\n            if (next == INT_MAX) break;  // No more points can be added\n            member = next;\n            ++count;\n        }\n\n        if (tid == 0) card[s] = count;\n    }\n}\n\n}  // namespace\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (CUDA)\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    if (N == 0) return clusters;\n\n    int device = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDevice(&device));\n    cudaDeviceProp prop;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&prop, device));\n\n    const bool useSmem = static_cast<size_t>(N) * sizeof(double) <= kMaxSmemBytes;\n    if (useSmem) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncSetAttribute(growClustersKernel<true, false>,\n                                        cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize,\n                                        static_cast<int>(kMaxSmemBytes)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncSetAttribute(growClustersKernel<true, true>,\n                                        cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize,\n                                        static_cast<int>(kMaxSmemBytes)));\n    }\n\n    // Global-scratch fallback for very large point counts: bound the number\n    // of resident blocks so that the scratch stays within ~1 GiB.\n    int maxBlocks = N;\n    double* dScratch = nullptr;\n    if (!useSmem) {\n        const size_t budget = static_cast<size_t>(1) << 30;\n        const size_t perBlock = static_cast<size_t>(N) * sizeof(double);\n        maxBlocks = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(N, std::max<size_t>(1, budget / perBlock)));\n        maxBlocks = std::min(maxBlocks, prop.multiProcessorCount * 32);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dScratch, static_cast<size_t>(maxBlocks) * perBlock));\n    }\n\n    double2* dPts = nullptr;\n    int* dCard = nullptr;\n    int* {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011CgMQXWyVFrVss5KZVgrK1","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01HkASxQBsK4Arh3PFXhtWYJ","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 - <<'PYEOF'\nimport re\nsrc = open('qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp').read()\nstart = src.index('// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\\n// CUDA kernels')\nend = src.index('// Validation: check that clusters satisfy')\nnew_mid = r'''// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA kernels\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nnamespace {\n\nconstexpr int kBlockSize = 256;\nconstexpr int kWarpSize = 32;\nconstexpr int kNumWarps = kBlockSize / kWarpSize;\nconstexpr int kMaxBlocksPerSM = 2048 / kBlockSize;\n// Largest dynamic shared memory allocation we are willing to request for the\n// per-candidate running-maximum array (96 KiB, available on sm_70+).\nconstexpr size_t kMaxSmemBytes = 96 * 1024;\n\n// Squared distance. The original algorithm compares Euclidean distances\n// sqrt(d2); since sqrt is monotonic and correctly rounded, max over members\n// commutes with sqrt, \"sqrt(d2) < threshold\" is equivalent to \"d2 < T\" for a\n// suitably chosen bound T (see squaredThresholdBound), and the argmin is\n// resolved on squared values with an exact fallback for the (practically\n// non-existent) case where distinct squared values round to the same sqrt.\n__device__ __forceinline__ double devDistance2(const double2 a, const double2 b) {\n    const double dx = a.x - b.x;\n    const double dy = a.y - b.y;\n    return dx * dx + dy * dy;\n}\n\n// (value, index) pair ordering identical to the sequential scan: a candidate\n// replaces the current best only if it is strictly closer, so among equal\n// distances the smallest index wins.\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool betterThan(double v, int i, double bv, int bi) {\n    return (v < bv) || (v == bv && i < bi);\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ void warpArgMin(double& v, int& i) {\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int off = kWarpSize / 2; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n        const double ov = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, v, off);\n        const int oi = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, i, off);\n        if (betterThan(ov, oi, v, i)) {\n            v = ov;\n            i = oi;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Selection state: smallest value (with smallest index among equals), the\n// smallest value strictly greater than it, and the number of valid candidates.\nstruct Sel {\n    double min1;\n    int idx;\n    double min2;\n    int cnt;\n};\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ void mergeSel(Sel& a, const Sel& b) {\n    a.cnt += b.cnt;\n    if (b.min1 < a.min1) {\n        a.min2 = fmin(a.min1, b.min2);\n        a.min1 = b.min1;\n        a.idx = b.idx;\n    } else if (b.min1 == a.min1) {\n        a.idx = min(a.idx, b.idx);\n        a.min2 = fmin(a.min2, b.min2);\n    } else {\n        a.min2 = fmin(a.min2, b.min1);\n    }\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ void warpMergeSel(Sel& s) {\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int off = kWarpSize / 2; The original algorithm compares Euclidean distances\n// sqrt(d2); since sqrt is monotonic and correctly rounded, max over members\n// commutes with sqrt, \"sqrt(d2) < threshold\" is equivalent to \"d2 < T\" for a\n// suitably chosen bound T (see squaredThresholdBound), and the argmin is\n// resolved on squared values with an exact fallback for the (practically\n// non-existent) case where distinct squared values round to the same sqrt.\n__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ double distance2(const double2 a, const double2 b) {\n    const double dx = a.x - b.x;\n    const double dy = a.y - b.y;\n    return dx * dx + dy * dy;\n}\n\n// (value, index) pair ordering identical to the sequential scan: a candidate\n// replaces the current best only if it is strictly closer, so among equal\n// distances the smallest index wins.\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool betterThan(double v, int i, double bv, int bi) {\n    return (v < bv) || (v == bv && i < bi);\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ void warpArgMin(double& v, int& i) {\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int off = kWarpSize / 2; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n        const double ov = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, v, off);\n        const int oi = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, i, off);\n        if (betterThan(ov, oi, v, i)) {\n            v = ov;\n            i = oi;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Selection state: smallest value (with smallest index among equals), the\n// smallest value strictly greater than it, and the number of valid candidates.\nstruct Sel {\n    double min1;\n    int idx;\n    double min2;\n    int cnt;\n};\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ void mergeSel(Sel& a, const Sel& b) {\n    a.cnt += b.cnt;\n    if (b.min1 < a.min1) {\n        a.min2 = fmin(a.min1, b.min2);\n        a.min1 = b.min1;\n        a.idx = b.idx;\n    } else if (b.min1 == a.min1) {\n        a.idx = min(a.idx, b.idx);\n        a.min2 = fmin(a.min2, b.min2);\n    } else {\n        a.min2 = fmin(a.min2, b.min1);\n    }\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ void warpMergeSel(Sel& s) {\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int off = kWarpSize / 2; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n        Sel o;\n        o.min1 = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, s.min1, off);\n        o.idx = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, s.idx, off);\n        o.min2 = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, s.min2, off);\n        o.cnt = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, s.cnt, off);\n        mergeSel(s, o);\n    }\n}\n\n// Packed (cardinality, seed) with the ordering used to pick the round's\n// cluster: larger cardinality first, then the smaller seed index.\n__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ unsigned long long packBest(int card, int seed, int U) {\n    return (static_cast<unsigned long long>(static_cast<unsigned int>(card)) << 32) |\n           static_cast<unsigned int>(U - seed);\n}\n__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int packedCard(unsigned long long p) {\n    return static_cast<int>(p >> 32);\n}\n__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int packedSeed(unsigned long long p, int U) {\n    return U - static_cast<int>(p & 0xffffffffu);\n}\n\n// Number of points within the threshold of each point; used only as a\n// scheduling heuristic (ordering of seeds) for the first round.\n__global__ void neighborCountKernel(const double2* __restrict__ pts, int N, double T,\n                                    int* __restrict__ out) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= N) return;\n    const double2 p = pts[i];\n    int cnt = 0;\n    for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n        if (distance2(p, pts[j]) < T) ++cnt;\n    }\n    out[i] = cnt;\n}\n\n// Marks every point that lies within the threshold of some member of the\n// cluster chosen in this round (header/member list taken from `out`). Only\n// such seeds can have their candidate cluster changed by the removal.\n__global__ void affectedKernel(const double2* __restrict__ pts, int U, double T,\n                               const int* __restrict__ out, int N, int* __restrict__ flags) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= U) return;\n    const int card = out[0];\n    const int* members = out {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01EvVL2WYL1CBexUWhXeP9fL","type":"tool_result","content":"// QT Clustering Benchmark - CUDA Parallel Version\n//\n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n//\n// Parallelization strategy (CUDA):\n//   Every outer iteration of the algorithm has to grow one candidate cluster\n//   from each still-unclustered seed point. These candidate clusters are\n//   completely independent of each other, so each one is grown by its own\n//   thread block. Inside a block, the threads cooperatively own the set of\n//   candidate points: for each candidate the block keeps the running maximum\n//   distance to the members already in the cluster (updated incrementally\n//   whenever a new member joins, which is exactly the maximum the original\n//   code recomputes from scratch), and a block-wide argmin reduction selects\n//   the next member with the same tie-breaking as the sequential scan\n//   (smallest distance, then smallest index). Only the cardinality of each\n//   candidate cluster is produced in this pass; the winning cluster is then\n//   re-grown by a single block to enumerate its members.\n//\n//   The unclustered points are compacted into a dense array (in ascending\n//   index order) before every iteration so that no work is spent on points\n//   that are already clustered.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n...\n624:    cudaDeviceProp prop;\n775:            double2* hPts0 = reinterpret_cast<double2*>(hSeedOrder + 4);\n778:                hPts0[i] = make_double2(points[active[i]].x, points[active[i]].y);\n780:            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dPts0, hPts0, static_cast<size_t>(U) * sizeof(double2),\n1082:        cudaDeviceProp prop;\n1084:        printf(\"CUDA device: %s (%d SMs)\\n\", prop.name, prop.multiProcessorCount);\n1164 qtclustering.cpp\ncmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)\n\nproject(qtclustering LANGUAGES CXX CUDA)\n\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD 17)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\n\nif(NOT CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES)\n    set(CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES 86)\nendif()\n\n# The whole program (host + device code) lives in qtclustering.cpp; compile it\n# with the CUDA compiler.\nset_source_files_properties(qtclustering.cpp PROPERTIES LANGUAGE CUDA)\n\nadd_executable(qtclustering qtclustering.cpp)\n\ntarget_compile_options(qtclustering PRIVATE\n    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-O3 -Xcompiler=-O3,-march=native,-Wall,-Wextra>\n    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-O3 -march=native -Wall -Wextra>)\n\n# Link math library\ntarget_link_libraries(qtclustering m)","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"462f68a6-7f2d-4ad7-ae67-6b95a9b67f28","uuid":"f0bf4685-8cd3-4269-98d3-332b6198e5f0","timestamp":"2026-10-24T17:16:35.799Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"// QT Clustering Benchmark - CUDA Parallel Version\n//\n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n//\n// Parallelization strategy (CUDA):\n//   Every outer iteration of the algorithm has to grow one candidate cluster\n//   from each still-unclustered seed point. Only the cardinality of each\n//   candidate cluster is produced in this pass; the winning cluster is then\n//   re-grown by a single block to enumerate its members.\n//\n//   The unclustered points are compacted into a dense array (in ascending\n//   index order) before every iteration so that no work is spent on points\n//   that are already clustered.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n...\n624:    cudaDeviceProp prop;\n775:            double2* hPts0 = reinterpret_cast<double2*>(hSeedOrder + 4);\n778:                hPts0[i] = make_double2(points[active[i]].x, points[active[i]].y);\n780:            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dPts0, hPts0, static_cast<size_t>(U) * sizeof(double2),\n1082:        cudaDeviceProp prop;\n1084:        printf(\"CUDA device: %s (%d SMs)\\n\", prop.name, prop.multiProcessorCount);\n1164 qtclustering.cpp\ncmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)\n\nproject(qtclustering LANGUAGES CXX CUDA)\n\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD 17)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\n\nif(NOT CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES)\n    set(CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES 86)\nendif()\n\n# The whole program (host + device code) lives in qtclustering.cpp; compile it\n# with the CUDA compiler.\nset_source_files_properties(qtclustering.cpp PROPERTIES LANGUAGE CUDA)\n\nadd_executable(qtclustering qtclustering.cpp)\n\ntarget_compile_options(qtclustering PRIVATE\n    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-O3 -Xcompiler=-O3,-march=native,-Wall,-Wextra>\n    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-O3 -march=native -Wall -Wextra>)\n\n# Link math library\ntarget_link_libraries(qtclustering m)","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011CgMSZQkyNtZ4wxynWkZy6","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The CUDA port is complete and verified. Only the two existing files were changed: `qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp` and `qtclustering/CMakeLists.txt`.\n\n**Results** (RTX 3090, identical cluster-membership hashes to the sequential reference in every case):\n\n| Input | Sequential | CUDA |\n|---|---|---|\n| N=1000, t=2.0 | 7018 ms | 10 ms |\n| N=2000, t=2.0 | 88650 ms | 36 ms |\n| N=4000 | not run | 181 ms |\n| N=8000 | not run | 1035 ms |\n| N=16000 (global-memory path) | not run | 6186 ms |\n\nTwelve configurations (N from 31 to 2000, thresholds from 0.01 to 100) match the reference hash exactly, and the built-in validation passes on all sizes tested.\n\n**How it works**\n\n- Each still-unclustered seed's candidate cluster is grown by one thread block from a persistent grid with a work queue. The block keeps a running per-candidate maximum distance, so each growth step costs O(U) instead of O(U times cluster size), and a block-wide reduction picks the next member with the original tie-breaking (closest, then lowest index).\n- The hot loop uses squared distances. The threshold test uses a precomputed bound that is exactly equivalent to the original sqrt comparison, and near-ties between distinct squared values fall back to the exact sqrt comparison. I verified a build that forces the fallback on every step still produces identical results.\n- Seeds that can no longer beat the round's best finished cluster are abandoned early, with seeds scheduled largest-estimate first. A reversed-order build gives identical results, confirming the pruning is exact.\n- Across rounds, a seed's result is reused unless a removed point lies within the threshold of that seed, which is the only way its greedy growth could change. Member lists for the winner and runner-up are recorded during the pass, so no re-grow pass is needed.\n- Points fit in shared memory up to about 12k points.
